page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE,
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D. 17
CENTRAL I. B.
Date January 30, 1929）
Subject (in full) A. Orloff . Application to SMC for employment .
Made by P.C.S. Luklaevsky Forwarded by [签名]
With reference to the attached application inquiries
show that applicant, A. Orloff, White Russian, residing at
13A Park Terrace, Scott Road, arrived in Shanghai from
Vladivostock in 1923 after the White Russian Army had been
defeated by the Bolsheviks. After his arrival he obtained
casual employment as a pianist in different Russian Restaurants.
In 1925 he opened an advertising Company which, however, was
not very successful and in 1926 during the General Strike he
joined the Asiatic Petroleum Coy., where he was employed until
the end of the strike in June 1927. He then became manager of the
Russian Vodka Factory "Mercury" at 269 Avenue Joffre until
November 1927, when he opened his own Mineral Water Coy., "Elite",
which closed in November 1928 owing to business depression. He
is now a Lieutenant in the Russian Company of the S.V.C.
Orloff is generally regarded as having a shady
reputation.
B. Maklaevsky.
P. C. B.
A/D.C.I.
NR. 3069.
[签名]
Application returned to Secretariat
'No vacancy'
(Sgd) RMJM.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记科
编号 L. O. D. 17
中央情报局
日期 1929年1月30日）
事由（全称）A. Orloff。向工部局申请受雇。
由警员 Luklaevsky 提出 转呈 [签名]
关于所附申请，经查询显示，申请人 A. Orloff，白俄，居住于斯科特路公园台地13A号，在白俄军队被布尔什维克击败后，于1923年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。抵沪后，他在不同的俄国餐馆零星受雇担任钢琴师。1925年，他开办了一家广告公司，但经营不太成功；1926年大罢工期间，他加入亚细亚火油公司，任职至1927年6月罢工结束。随后，他成为霞飞路269号“墨丘利”俄国伏特加酒厂的经理，直至1927年11月，当时他开设了自己的“精英”矿泉水公司，该公司因商业萧条于1928年11月停业。他目前是上海义勇队俄国连的中尉。
Orloff 普遍被认为名声不佳。
B. Maklaevsky。
警务处乙组
助理刑事侦缉督察
编号 3069。
[签名]
申请书退回秘书处
“无空缺”
（签署）RMJM。
